changes: Primitive packed words now rehash existing canonical nodes directly after one optimal bucket allocation; the native path no longer allocates a destination-index Vec.

An invariant typed PackedWordReader<W> capability is constructible only by this crate for u32/u64, with primitive cast/identity readers; safe external code cannot inject callbacks into the destructive path.
PackedWord defaults to no capability, preserving the custom-word precompute/Vec path and original plus delayed hash-panic strong ownership guarantees. No public static lifetime bound was added.
Nonzero modulus and representable terminal-slot count are established before allocation or mutation.

observations: exact private native node HashCode result
every Standard optimal allocation and matching old-pointer Free in the rehash window
every C++ global new/delete in the window; none occurs on native rehash
exact new bucket count, extent and iteration sequence

destructive_operation_proof.reason: PackedWord associated const defaults None. Only private u32/u64 capability constants have values; fn(W)->W PhantomData makes W invariant. External compiler checks reject field construction, different word substitution and function mutation.
Canonical nodes are uniquely owned and the mask accessor copies a Copy word field. No user method executes during copying.

destructive_operation_proof.operation: Widen, shift, cast, reduce and add one
destructive_operation_proof.reason: Capability invokes only the crate u32-to-u64 cast or u64 identity. A boolean width selects shift5/6. NonZeroUsize excludes division by zero; remainder is below modulus, so plus1 cannot overflow. Casting after shifting reproduces native size_t truncation.
Replacement length is checked modulus+1 before allocation. Every computed target is in1..=modulus, so internal table bounds checks cannot panic for a valid canonical table.

destructive_operation_proof.operation: Unlink, read Next, set Next, prepend
destructive_operation_proof.reason: Only private raw pointers from owned canonical nodes are used. Next/SetNext have no callbacks. No allocation or user trait call remains between unlink and relink.

Old heads are empty after transfer; existing optimal raw owner releases the old table once before map modulus commit. Original node identities and chains remain covered by the engine/original/Miri suites.

heap_observation: A test-only System wrapper records all alloc, alloc_zeroed, realloc and dealloc calls in fixed thread-local storage without observer heap allocation. Native global new/delete and Standard AllocateOptimal/Free are interposed. Rust raw payload headers are explicitly subtracted (16bytes) and alignment16 required; native Free(nullptr) is removed only when comparing effective heap calls. No arbitrary extra allocation is filtered out. Backend singleton initialization and fixture/population setup occur before the measured ReSize window.
generic_extensions: A nonstatic borrowed word compiles and retains observed scratch allocation; early and delayed custom word panics preserve graph identities, values and modulus. Custom keys with primitive u32/u64 words may panic in key conversions, but native rehash never calls those conversions. These Rust-only contracts carry no native API completion credit.

miri_exclusions.reason: Only prior positive libc-backtrace iterator tests require machine frames. Privacy compile-fail probes use the real external compiler separately, not Miri.

bindings.scope: Primitive word arithmetic and actual no-scratch rehash integration; public Node::hash_code remains the generic callable contract. Global parity credit stays zero.

remaining_gaps: Custom open words intentionally retain transactional destination scratch; OCCT supports integral template arguments and has no equivalent user word callback path.
Existing raw allocation headers and lazy backend handle setup still differ in physical heap requests from native malloc; alternate OCCT memory managers are not covered.
True null-allocation fatal signals and overflowing native bucket arithmetic remain outside the claimed defined-domain equivalence; no fatal host exhaustion is executed.
C++ object ABI, compiler array cookies, and global API crosswalk reconciliation remain separate.
